arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Test case-insensitive findall
result = parse.findall('{word}', 'Hello world hello WORLD', case_sensitive=False)
print('case_sensitive=False:', result)

result = parse.findall('{word}', 'Hello world hello WORLD', case_sensitive=True)
print('case_sensitive=True:', result)

# Verify Result slicing
r = parse.parse('{a} {b} {c} {d}', '1 2 3 4')
print('Result:', r)
print('r[0]:', r[0])
print('r[-1]:', r[-1])
print('r[1:3]:', r[1:3])
print('r[:2]:', r[:2])
print('r[::2]:', r[::2])
"
